blocks.text: Janwar ki jins (sex) us ki janeeni nashonuma ke dauran tay hoti hai. Zyada tar janwaron mein jins karyotype ki bunyad par tay hoti hai, yaani cells mein chromosomes ke poore set ki shakal, jis mein un ki tadaad, size aur banawat shamil hai.

Zyada tar janwaron ke karyotype mein aik jore ke siwa sab chromosome jore maada aur nar mein aik jaise hote hain. Dono mein bilkul aik jaise chromosomes autosomes hain; jo aik jora mukhtalif hai aur jins tay karta hai woh sex chromosomes hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: Drosophila, maada mein autosomes ke teen jore (do bare, aik nanha) aur do daande jaise X chromosomes, nar mein wahi autosomes aur aik X aur aik kunde jaisa Y. Daen: insan ke 22 numbered autosome jore 1 se 22 tak chhote hote hue, neele aur surkh saathi, aur neeche aurat XX aur mard XY, Y kaafi chhota.
blocks.caption: Drosophila aur insan mein autosomes aur sex chromosomes (Figure 18.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Karyotype cell ke chromosomes ka poora set hai jo un ki tadaad, size aur shakal se bayan hota hai. Nar aur maada mein aik jore ke siwa sab jore aik jaise hote hain: aik jaise jore autosomes aur alag jora sex chromosomes hain. Drosophila mein autosomes ke 3 jore aur sex chromosomes ka 1 jora; insan mein autosomes ke 22 jore aur sex chromosomes ka 1 jora. Dono mein maada XX aur nar XY, Y Drosophila mein kunde jaisa aur insan mein X se kaafi chhota. Yeh khaaka paimane (scale) par nahi.

blocks.explanation: 44, yaani 22 jore, aur sex chromosomes ka aik jora, kul 46.

items: Karyotype: cell ke chromosomes ki tadaad, size aur shakal.
Autosomes dono jinson mein aik jaise; sex chromosomes ka aik jora mukhtalif.
